paper.title: Multi-Metric Adaptive Experimental Design Under a Fixed Budget with Validation

settings.name_in_paper: Multi-Metric Multi-Armed Bandit (M3AB) with heterogeneous variance, fixed-budget exploration followed by A/B validation
settings.out_of_scope_reason: Multi-objective (vector-valued, M metrics) rewards; ontology scope excludes multi-objective rewards.
unmapped: Rewards are M-dimensional vectors with independent Gaussian metrics; per-arm, per-metric variances are known (heterogeneous) to the learner
A distinguished control arm 0 plus A treatments; the target is the treatment maximizing min over metrics of the z value (mu_{a,i}-mu_{0,i})/sqrt(sigma_{a,i}^2+sigma_{0,i}^2)+xi_{a,i}
The learner knows the validation constants xi_{a,i} (validation horizon T_v, confidence levels delta_i or posterior thresholds q_i and prior variances tau_i)
settings.definition_quote: We consider a stochastic MAB model with $A+1$ arms denoted as $\gA = \{0, 1, \cdots, A\}$. The arm $0$ is called control ... The rewards of arms are vectors of dimension $M$ ... $\nu_{a,i}$ is a normal distribution ... We assume the expectations are unknown to the agent but $\{\vsigma_a^2\}$ are known. ... the performance is measured by the probability of error, i.e., $\sP(\hat{a} \neq a^*)$.

algorithms.name: SHRVar-c (Sequential Halving with Relative Variance and Confidence-Based Elimination)

symbols.A_tr: number of treatments A (arms excluding the control)
symbols.H_3: complexity measure H_3 = (min_{S containing a*} min_{a in S'_c} D_{S,a}^2/(rho_{S,Sigma}+lambda_{S,Sigma})^2)^{-1} based on z-value effective gaps and relative variances

conditions: metrics are independent Gaussian with known variances

source.label: thm:estimate
source.quote: If we use \texttt{SHRVar} in algorithm~\ref{alg:mosh} to identify the best treatment $a^*$ in our exploration phase, the probability of mistake can be upper bounded as: \prob\left( \hat{a}\neq a^* \right) \leq 6 M \log_2 A \cdot \exp\left( -\frac{T}{2 H_3 \log_2 A} \right).

results.notes: Error probability P(hat a != a*) where a* maximizes the minimum z value over metrics. 'probability' field set to expectation as it is a bound on a probability of error.

symbols.H_3_tilde: complexity measure tilde H_3, analogous to H_3 with effective gap tilde D_{S,a} that includes terms depending on Delta_min (min z-value gap of bottleneck metric) and 8 A log_2^2 A / T

conditions: metrics are independent Gaussian with known variances

source.label: thm:conf
source.quote: If we use \texttt{SHRVar-c} in algorithm~\ref{alg:shrvarc} to identify the best treatment $a^*$ in our exploration phase, the probability of mistake can be upper bounded as: \prob\left( \hat{a}\neq a^* \right) \leq 6 M \log_2 A \cdot \exp\left( -\frac{T}{2 \tilde{H}_3 \log_2 A} \right).

results.notes: Recorded as stated; the appendix proof actually derives a factor 8 instead of 2 in the exponent denominator (T/(8 tilde H_3 log_2 A)), so the stated constant may be inconsistent. tilde H_3 depends on T itself via the 8A log_2^2 A/T term.
